description: Research in distributed systems and decentralized protocols at NOVA-LINCS, advised by Prof. João Leitão.
Thesis: A Systems Approach to Minimize Wasted Work in Blockchains.
Proposed a p2p communication approach for blockchain networks that reduced latency by ~34% and cut uncle blocks in proof-of-work chains (Bitcoin and Ethereum at the time) by ~77%.
Research assistant at the computer science lab.
